dedupe_keys.name: urbanisticki plan uređenja podrucja između preloske i ulice ljudevita gaja u svetom đurđu

description: Urbanistički plan uređenja područja između Preloške i Ulice Ljudevita Gaja u Svetom Đurđu is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Općina Sveti Đurđ. Urban development plan for the area between Preloška and Ljudevita Gaja Street in Sveti Đurđ (‘Official Gazette of Varaždin County’ Nos 129/21, 115/25 and 119/25. – corrigendum to the publication). Coverage: Općina Sveti Đurđ. The portal shows the English title as "Urban planning of the area between Preloška and Ljudevita Gaja Street in Sveti Đurđ" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Općina Sveti Đurđ. Its keywords include prostorni planovi. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.gov.hr/otvorena-dozvola). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-portal-otvorenih-podataka.
